steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each rule is matched to the layout approach it uses: container or viewport.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Viewport query on a component that adapts to its container

outcome.notChecked: Rendering in real browsers and devices, styles generated at run time, third-party widget styles, and visual design quality beyond these checks.

pros: Checks layout (container queries, not viewport queries or resize listeners, for components that adapt to their container; grid for two-dimensional layout and subgrid where supported; intrinsic sizing and cla.
cons: Not checked: Rendering in real browsers and devices, styles generated at run time, third-party widget styles, and visual design quality beyond these checks.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-web-css-layout skill on the records for this review.
